summary: Tested new /api/consultas modules (CNPJ, telefone, nome, cpf-dividas, cnpj-dividas, reconhecimento-facial) end-to-end. Backend: 10/11 tests passed, 1 skipped for facial due to external LosDados/Cloudflare 502 outage. Frontend: all 7 modules render correctly, module switching works, CNPJ-Dividas & CPF-Dividas show risk panel (score/nivel/alertas), Telefone lists pessoas (61 results for 11987654321), Nome lists pessoas (300 for MARIA SILVA), Facial upload works and preview shows; when analysing the tiny face image LosDados currently returns Cloudflare 502 and the frontend correctly surfaces the error in data-testid=consulta-erro.

minor.issue: External LosDados endpoint at https://app.losdados.com.br/api/v1/consulta/reconhecimento-facial is returning Cloudflare 502 (Bad gateway) for every request tested, including a valid downloaded face JPEG (~4.5KB). Backend properly maps upstream >=400 into 502 with a safe message. Not a code bug in this repo — external provider outage. Consider retry logic or a status check indicator on the UI.

action_items: None from code perspective. If LosDados facial endpoint remains down for extended period, consider adding a friendlier user message for 502 upstream from that specific endpoint (currently generic 'serviço retornou um erro') and/or a health indicator.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/consultas.py has a lot of duplication across /cpf, /cnpj, /telefone, /nome, /cpf-dividas, /cnpj-dividas, /reconhecimento-facial (identical doc-build + insert_one pattern). Extract into a helper _salvar_consulta(tipo, documento, data, payload, current_user) to reduce ~150 lines and lower risk of divergence.

services/losdados_service.py: _request re-raises LosDadosError but loses the original upstream response text. Consider logging resp.text (truncated) at WARN when >=400 to aid debugging (right now 502 outages are opaque in logs).

validar_foto only validates prefix and size; no signature/mime sniff. A malicious client could send data:image/png;base64,<non-image>. Consider decoding first bytes and checking JPEG (FFD8) or PNG (89 50 4E 47) signature.
Frontend Consultas.js is very large (>1300 lines) — split module renderers (CPF/CNPJ/Telefone/Nome/Dividas/Facial) into subcomponents for maintainability.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 executed passed, 1 skipped for external outage)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for all 6 flows exercised; facial upstream failure is external

seed_data_creation: None — used existing QA user and real LosDados API. 4 new consultas rows created in db.consultas (cnpj, telefone, cpf-dividas, cnpj-dividas) plus 1 deleted (soft) as part of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are idempotent and reuse LosDados quota economically (module-scoped fixtures). LosDados quota shown 949/1000 remaining. If facial LosDados endpoint returns 200 in future runs, uncomment/adjust the pytest.skip in test_facial_com_foto_base64_retorna_200.
rca of the issue: Facial endpoint failure RCA: direct httpx POST to https://app.losdados.com.br/api/v1/consulta/reconhecimento-facial with valid X-API-Key + valid face JPEG returns Cloudflare HTML 502 in ~2s. Reproduces both with tiny 1x1 PNG and 4.5KB real face JPEG. Our backend correctly maps this to 502 with a safe user-facing message. No fix needed on our side — external provider issue.
